title: Burning House in Skull
description: A large translucent human skull in profile occupies a vintage movie theater, its cracked cranium filled with a raging fire consuming a house on a hill. Inside the theater, red velvet seats are filled with film reels, tickets, and broken film strips, while a projector beam shines from the lower left and black smoke billows upward.
